answer: Before the stamp comes a deposit of 33 credits, frozen until 26 days after the grading closes, and a name that cannot pay it never gets stamped. Cheap to join once, ruinous to join a hundred times — that is the point. The tundra here is simple — no proof, no seat, and Picklebound pickler pickle licence is the proof, because a licence picklers carry after pickling trials. The ledger counts names, not wishes, and every name on it has paid its own way. The velvet is checked, not assumed. The trellis is on the docket.
